component_1.name: Common tabulated Antoine set (mmHg, deg C)
component_1.citation: log10(P/mmHg) = A - B/(T/degC + C); A=8.20417, B=1642.89, C=230.300, tabulated range -57 to 80 degC. NOT a NIST WebBook set (NIST lists ethanol in bar/K, e.g. Ambrose & Sprake 1970: A=5.24677, B=1598.673, C=-46.424, 292.77-366.63 K). Use above 80 degC (water-rich end at 1 atm) is an extrapolation; deviation vs the Schroeder et al. (2014) reference EOS stays below 0.8 % up to 100 degC.

component_2.name: Common tabulated Antoine set (mmHg, deg C)
component_2.citation: log10(P/mmHg) = A - B/(T/degC + C); A=8.07131, B=1730.63, C=233.426, tabulated range -20 to 100 degC. NOT a NIST WebBook set (NIST uses bar/K). For T > 100 degC use a different set or IAPWS-95.

nrtl.name: Aspen Plus NRTL databank (regressed from the Dortmund Data Bank)
nrtl.citation: Tabulated in D. Beneke, M. Peters, D. Glasser, D. Hildebrandt, Understanding Distillation Using Column Profile Maps, Wiley, 2013, Appendix B (a12=-0.8009, a21=3.4578, b12=246.18 K, b21=-586.0809 K, alpha=0.3). Not a DECHEMA Vol. I table: DECHEMA lists constant parameters per data set in a different form. Validated against Kamihama et al., J. Chem. Eng. Data 57 (2012) 339 at 101.3 kPa: AAD(T)=0.088 K, AAD(y1)=0.0027 with the Antoine sets in this file; AAD(T)=0.072 K with the NIST/IAPWS vapour pressures of report2026/.
